author: reek
body: Code browser for the dev console. CodeBrowser indexes all function and type definitions by name via a prefix trie, enabling instant search and autocomplete. CodeBrowser loads source from the embedded filesystem on the boot image.

author: reek
body: Bridges a CodeBrowser DefLocation to an AnnotationTarget so the Reader can pull annotations attached to the definition currently on screen. Read-only -- H1 does not author or filter.

author: reek
body: Builds an Overlay tooltip listing the annotations that target a definition. The bubble is a vertical panel of labels, one per annotation, formatted as "[kind] body -- author". The caller supplies screen coordinates; trust filtering and per-kind styling are deferred to later H phases.
